entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The elder artificer brother who builds constructs for Yotia and Argive, uses the Golgothian Sylex to destroy Argoth, and ascends as a planeswalker with the Mightstone and Weakstone as eyes.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: The younger brother who tames a dragon engine with his Weakstone, leads the Fallaji, and replaces his flesh with Phyrexian machinery under Gix's influence.

entities.name: Tocasia
entities.description: An archaeologist who mentors the brothers and is killed when the brothers' powerstones explode.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Urza's apprentice, who carries the Sylex to him and is told of Mishra's death.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Mishra's sadistic and brilliant artificer apprentice, who obtains the Golgothian Sylex and gives her life to let Tawnos escape.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: A Phyrexian demon with black lizard skin and jutting bones who reopens the portal, creates the Brotherhood of Gix, and becomes Mishra's chief advisor.

entities.name: Brotherhood of Gix
entities.description: A group of dominated humans who infiltrate both sides of the war to feed information to Gix.

entities.name: Thran
entities.description: The ancient race whose artifacts Tocasia studies.

entities.name: Fallaji
entities.description: The desert people who use Mishra and his dragon engine to unite their clans.

entities.name: Yotia
entities.description: A coastal nation where Urza wins the Warlord's daughter's hand and thrives; it falls to Mishra's dragon engines.

entities.name: Argive
entities.description: A coastal nation to which Urza retreats and is named Lord Protector.

entities.name: Korlis
entities.description: A coastal nation annexed by Urza.

entities.name: Sardia
entities.description: A nation annexed by Urza.

entities.name: Sarinth
entities.description: A nation conquered by Mishra.

entities.name: Terisia City
entities.description: A western city conquered by Mishra's forces.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: The continent on which the Brothers' War is fought.

entities.name: Koilos
entities.description: The secret heart of Thran civilization, where the brothers find the powerstone and where a portal to Phyrexia is found.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The other world reached by a portal in Koilos.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: An untouched island southeast of Terisiare, home to elves, centaurs and treefolk, destroyed by the Sylex blast.

entities.name: Mightstone
entities.description: Urza's half of the powerstone, which gives machines strength.

entities.name: Weakstone
entities.description: Mishra's half of the powerstone, which weakens machines.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: A Thran artifact describing an apocalypse, used by Urza to destroy Argoth.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The decades-long conflict between Urza and Mishra over Terisiare.

entities.name: Sylex blast
entities.description: The explosion that destroys Argoth and obliterates both armies.

entities.name: Warlord of Yotia
entities.description: The ruler of Yotia whose daughter Urza marries and who attacks the Fallaji at the peace talks.

events.summary: The brothers and Tocasia discover Koilos, the secret heart of Thran civilization.
events.quote: In AR 20 the brothers and Tocasia discover Koilos

events.summary: When Urza and Mishra reach for the powerstone it explodes, splitting into two halves.
events.quote: when Mishra and Urza reach for the stone it explodes, splitting it into two halves

events.summary: A drunken Mishra fights Urza with their powerstones, and the resulting explosion kills Tocasia.
Urza wins the Warlord's daughter's hand in Yotia and takes Tawnos as apprentice, while Mishra tames a dragon engine with the Weakstone and unites the Fallaji.
events.quote: Mishra discovers a dragon engine war machine and tames it with his Weakstone.
Mishra takes on an apprentice in Ashnod

events.summary: At the peace negotiations, the Warlord attacks the Fallaji using Urza's machines before the brothers can reconcile; Mishra escapes.
events.quote: the Warlord attacks the Fallaji using Urza's machines

events.summary: Mishra and Ashnod find a portal to Phyrexia in Koilos and are attacked by the demon Gix, then close the portal.
events.quote: Mishra and Ashnod escape and close the portal.

events.summary: Yotia falls to Mishra's dragon engines, and Urza retreats to Argive where he is named Lord Protector.
events.quote: Urza retreats to Argive where he is named Lord Protector

events.summary: Mishra conquers Sarinth while Urza annexes Korlis and Sardia, and Ashnod obtains the Golgothian Sylex at Terisia City.
events.quote: Ashnod obtains a Thran artifact called the Golgothian Sylex

events.summary: Gix reopens the portal and creates the Brotherhood of Gix, becoming Mishra's chief advisor.
events.quote: He lures and dominates more humans to create the Brotherhood of Gix

events.summary: Urza discovers Argoth, Gix feeds the information to Mishra, and both brothers invade the island.
events.quote: By chance, Urza discovers the untouched island of Argoth to the southeast

events.summary: Ashnod gives Tawnos the Sylex and sacrifices herself to delay Gix.
events.quote: Ashnod delays him long enough to let Tawnos escape at the cost of her life

events.summary: Urza and Mishra fight directly; Urza sees Mishra has replaced his flesh with machinery.
events.quote: Urza sees that Mishra has replaced his flesh with machinery like the Gixians

events.summary: Urza releases the Sylex's energy, destroying Argoth and obliterating both armies.
Urza survives the blast and ascends as a planeswalker with his eyes replaced by the Mightstone and Weakstone.
events.quote: Urza survives the Sylex blast and ascends, becoming a planeswalker

events.summary: Urza tells Tawnos that Mishra is dead, killed years earlier by the Phyrexian demon, and says he must leave Terisiare.
events.quote: tells him that Mishra is dead but that the demon from Phyrexia had killed his brother years ago

relations.note: Brothers born in the same year.
relations.quote: Urza and Mishra are brothers living and working in the Fallaji desert
under the tutelage of their mentor Tocasia

relations.quote: Amid the chaos of the battle, Urza and Mishra fight each other directly.
